import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

id_col = "id"
target_col = "species"
train_feature_cols = [
    col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [target_col, id_col]
]
all_classes = sample_sub.columns.drop("id").tolist()

X_train_full = train_df[train_feature_cols]
y_train = train_df[target_col]
X_test_full = test_df[train_feature_cols]

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_full)

pca = PCA(n_components=0.95, random_state=42)
X_train_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_train_scaled)
X_val_pca = pca.transform(X_val_scaled)
X_test_pca = pca.transform(X_test_scaled)

print(
    f"Original features: {X_train_full.shape[1]}, PCA components: {X_train_pca.shape[1]}"
)

ensemble_val_preds = []
ensemble_test_preds = []
trained_classes_map = None

for seed in [42, 123, 456, 789, 321]:
    lr_model = LogisticRegression(
        multi_class="multinomial",
        solver="lbfgs",
        random_state=seed,
        max_iter=1000,
        C=1.0,
        class_weight="balanced",
    )
    lr_model.fit(X_train_pca, y_train)

    trained_classes = lr_model.classes_
    col_to_model_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(trained_classes)}
    col_ordering = [col_to_model_idx[col] for col in all_classes]

    val_probs = lr_model.predict_proba(X_val_pca)
    test_probs = lr_model.predict_proba(X_test_pca)

    val_probs_reordered = np.clip(val_probs[:, col_ordering], 1e-15, 1.0)
    test_probs_reordered = np.clip(test_probs[:, col_ordering], 1e-15, 1.0)

    ensemble_val_preds.append(val_probs_reordered)
    ensemble_test_preds.append(test_probs_reordered)

    if trained_classes_map is None:
        trained_classes_map = trained_classes
        print(f"Model classes: {trained_classes}")
        print(f"Submission classes: {all_classes}")
        print(f"Ordering check: {col_ordering}")

avg_val_probs = np.mean(ensemble_val_preds, axis=0)
avg_test_probs = np.mean(ensemble_test_preds, axis=0)

val_loss = log_loss(y_val, avg_val_probs, labels=all_classes)
print(f"Validation Log Loss (Ensemble): {val_loss:.6f}")
print(f"Previous best (PCA + LR single): 0.086435")

submission = pd.DataFrame()
submission["id"] = test_df[id_col]
submission[all_classes] = avg_test_probs
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to submission/submission.csv, shape: {submission.shape}")
print(
    f"Prob sums range: [{avg_test_probs.sum(axis=1).min():.4f}, {avg_test_probs.sum(axis=1).max():.4f}]"
)
